description: Replace string-based QuotaPeriod (daily/monthly/total) with structured discriminated-union objects supporting 5h sliding window, weekly, monthly, and total periods. Includes auto-migration from old format.
goal: Support 5h (sliding), weekly (fixed weekday), monthly (fixed day), and total quota reset periods with structured config and backward-compatible migration
architecture: Discriminated union type with `type` field. Each period type has its own fields. Auto-migration on config load. calculateResetAt handles each type's reset logic.
